synopsis: Out Laws follows three queer activists as they fight to overturn the colonial-era laws that still criminalise their lives. Their battle unfolds in a moment of escalating jeopardy: activists are being murdered, churches and politicians are mobilising against LGBTQIA+ rights, and foreign actors are exporting hate across the Global South. From tense courtrooms to private moments of fear and determination, the film reveals what it means to resist when the cost can be everything. Visually bold and em
tmdb_overview: A powerful documentary that follows gay Namibian activist Friedel Dausab as he challenges his country’s criminalisation of same-sex love. In June 2022, Friedel files a landmark lawsuit against the government, becoming a beacon of hope for LGBTQIA+ Namibians seeking safety and equality. Facing death threats, public hostility, and immense personal risk, he takes his fight to court while awaiting judgment. The film also traces the colonial roots of queer criminalisation—from Tudor England to its export across the Global South through empire and later reinforced by Christian evangelism. Alongside fellow activists from Sri Lanka and Barbados, Friedel travels to London, where history, protest, and Pride converge. Blending legal battle with historical insight, the documentary is both an urgent exposé of injustice and a stirring celebration of queer resilience, courage, and resistance.

tmdb_original_title: Parmi les montagnes et les ruisseaux
tmdb_overview: A mysterious forest in early fall echoes with birdsong and the sound of a river. Fallen leaves speckle gold on the blue stones. Two weary travellers make their way on foot – the painter Meng Huang and writer Ma Jian. When, as if after a long journey, they finally reach a cabin, they eat and drink, but the mood is not one of contentment. Their gaze is dark, haunted by memories of the China they have fled: persecution, resistance and the treatment meted out to those who fight for human rights. With the forest arousing painful thoughts and existential considerations, they talk about art. For the two artists, whose world view has been upended by the Tiananmen Square massacre, creation offers an answer to oppression and lies. But what kind of life remains for the exiles?

movie_title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
movie_title_en: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
synopsis: “Oasis: Don’t Look Back In Anger” charts Liam and Noel Gallagher’s triumphant reunion tour, Oasis Live ‘25, one of the most anticipated rock ‘n’ roll comebacks of our time. The film is an unapologetically uplifting account of the biggest musical event of 2025, capturing the experience and emotions of the band and their fans across the world. The unique perspective includes rehearsal, backstage, and onstage access as well as the first joint interview with Noel and Liam in over 20 years. Alongside the band’s sold-out world tour, the film also explores the profound emotional impact of this phenomenal global cultural moment and what their music means to audiences and generations worldwide.
tmdb_title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
tmdb_original_title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
tmdb_overview: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

synopsis:
500 Miles

strangers, they head to the wild west coast of Ireland, the home of their

from a multi generational cast.
tmdb_overview: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.

synopsis:
A Private Life 
Genre(s): Drama/MysteryFrance | 2026 | 107 mins (French with English Subtitles)Director: Rebecca ZlotowskiCast: Jodie Foster, Daniel Auteuil, Virginie Efira
Foster plays Lilian
Steiner, an American
psychiatrist adrift in Paris —
divorced, estranged from her son, and losing herself in her patients' troubles.
When one of her patients is found dead in an apparent suicide, Steiner can't let it go. Armed with little more
than professional instinct and the reluctant company of her ex-husband played
by Daniel Auteil, she begins to dig. What unfolds is part Hitchcockian thriller
and part wry relationship comedy.
This film contains flashing images which may affect viewers who are susceptible to photosensitive epilepsy
tmdb_overview: The renowned psychiatrist Lilian Steiner mounts a private investigation into the death of one of her patients, whom she is convinced has been murdered.

synopsis:
Animal Shorts + activities

The morning starts with Cinemini (nature inspired events for
toddlers). At 12pm we will screen a selection of short films featuring animals.
From a lynx exploring the city to a tiny fox discovering the magic of growing
things, these films invite us to join the world of our animal friends. After
the screening, children can create their own miniature animal habitats using
natural materials and found objects, including twigs, acorns, feathers, fabric
and more. (Animals not included!) The event finishes at 2.30pm. Presented
by Small World Cinema in association with
Croydon Harvest. Tickets £6.
tmdb_overview: Działania (Activities) documents a four-day action in a Warsaw television studio which can be understood as a “visual free-jazz concert,” or an attempt at interdisciplinary, collaborative improvisation. In their work, KwieKulik often attempt to mediate communication through different forms: language becomes movement, ideas transform into objects, improvisation acts as another form of theory. The surprising trajectory of these improvisations in sound, sculpture, discourse, performance and movement show the open-ended outcomes that Przemysław Kweik and Zofia Kulik were interested in pursuing during this period.

synopsis:
Bad Apples 
Genre(s): Comedy/ThrillerUSA/UK | 2025| 100 minsDirector: Jonathan EtzlerStars: Jacob Anderson, Saoirse Ronan, Robert EmmsOur Tuesday 7:30pm screening contains descriptive subtitles for those with hearing loss.A blackly comic British thriller,
adapted from the Swedish novel De Oönskare (The Unwanted), and starring
Saoirse Ronan as struggling primary school teacher Maria. After a behavioural
incident on a school trip, she makes an escalating series of bad choices.
Surprised however by the knock-on effects of these decisions, the audience is
ultimately left to decide the fallout from Maria's extreme approach to
classroom management. Featuring some incredibly realistic classroom scenes and
fantastic performances from Oscar nominee Ronan and her students played by
Eddie Waller and Nia Brown, this 2025 festival favourite is a must watch this
term.
tmdb_overview: A struggling primary school teacher begins to make some questionable decisions after one of her students is injured.

synopsis:
Bitter Christmas 
Genre(s): Comedy/DramaSpain | 2025 | 111 mins (Spanish with English Subtitles)Director: Pedro AlmodóvarStars: Bárbara Lennie, Leonardo Sbaraglia, Aitana Sánchez-GijónFrom acclaimed Spanish director Pedro Almodóvar comes Bitter
Christmas. This witty and bittersweet comedy-drama intertwines the
stories of Raúl and Elsa: Raúl is a filmmaker, writing his next screenplay;
Elsa is his imaginary alter ego. As Raúl struggles with writer’s block, he
shamelessly mines the lives of the people closest to him, blurring the
boundaries between art and reality. Almodóvar’s vibrant visual style and
trademark wit create a playful, provocative portrait of love, creativity and
the stories we steal to tell our own.
tmdb_overview: In 2025 Spain, a celebrated film director struggles to write the screenplay for an autofictional film set in 2004 Spain about an unsuccessful movie director turned director of commercials who suffers a panic attack that forces her to take a break by visiting the Canary Islands, where she begins work on a new film.

synopsis:
Cactus Pears  +ShortGenre(s): DramaUK/India/Canada | 2025 | 112 mins (Marathi with English Subtitles)Director: Rohan KanawadeStars: Bhushaan Manoj, Suraaj Suman, Jayshri Jagtap, Nitin Bansode, Harish Baraskar, Ram Daund, Vidya Joshi, Hemant Kadam, Rani Kasliwal, Vaishali Kendale
Cactus Pears is a
tender and deeply personal drama set against the striking landscapes of rural
Western India. Following the death of his father, Anand returns from Mumbai to
his ancestral village to observe traditional mourning rituals. Amid mounting
family expectations to marry, he finds an unexpected refuge in Balya, a
childhood friend. As old bonds are rekindled, their connection deepens into
something more. Beautifully shot, Kanawade’s debut is a subtle, moving
exploration of grief, identity and love. Sundance Film Festival 2025 World
Cinema Grand Jury Prize winner. 
Preceded by Two Black Boys in Paradise (9 mins), a
BAFTA-winning animated short.
tmdb_overview: Anand, a 30-something city dweller compelled to spend a 10-day mourning period for his father in the rugged countryside of western India, tenderly bonds with a local farmer who is struggling to stay unmarried. As the mourning ends, forcing his return, Anand must decide the fate of his relationship born under duress.

synopsis:
Cotton Queen 
Genre(s): DramaSUD/GER/FRA/PAL/EGY/QAT/SAU | 2025 | 93 Mins (Arabic with English Subtitles)Director: Suzannah MirghaniStars: Mihad Murtada, Rabha Mohamed Mahmoud, Talaat
Fareed
Mirghani’s
debut feature, a mixture of coming-of-age drama and post-colonial critique,
focusses on teenager Nafisa. Having grown up with her grandmother’s tales of
outsmarting the British, she works in the cotton fields of Sudan with her
friends. She is friendly with a local lad, but her mother has her sights set on
her marriage to Nadir, a British businessman eager to sell his genetically
modified cotton seed to the local farmers. Old practices such as FGM come
face-to-face with the modern world of corporate business and mobile phones in
this beautifully shot, arresting film.
Black History Month screening in conjunction with Croydon
Black History Partnership.
tmdb_overview: In a cotton-farming village in Sudan, teenage Nafisa is raised on heroic tales of battling British colonizers told by her grandmother, the village matriarch Al-Sit. But when a young businessman arrives from abroad with a new development plan and genetically engineered cotton, Nafisa becomes the center of a power play to determine the future of the village. Awakening to her own strength, Nafisa sets out to save the cotton fields – and herself. Neither she nor her community will ever be the same again.

synopsis:
Coyote Vs Acme 
Genre(s): Animation/Comedy/AdventureUSA | 2026 | 101 minsDirector: Dave GreenStars: Will Forte, Lana Condor, John CenaThis film contains flashing images which may affect viewers who are susceptible to photosensitive epilepsy.When loyal Acme
Corporation customer (and avowed enemy of Road Runner) Wile E. Coyote has
finally had enough of the company’s faulty goods, he’s left with one last
course of action: a lawsuit. Securing the services of ambulance-chasing
attorney Kevin Avery (Will Forte), the pair have to take on Acme’s hotshot
lawyer Buddy Crane (John Cena), who happens to be Avery’s former boss. Three
years after being shelved as a tax write-off by its studio, this madcap mix of
animation and live-action is seeing the light of day at long last, presenting
the world of Looney Tunes as you’ve never seen it before.
tmdb_overview: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

synopsis:
Dracula (Cert TBC) & Short film
Genre: HorrorUK | 1958 | 83 minsDirector: Terence Fisher
Stars: Peter Cushing, Christopher Lee, Michael Gough

A landmark in English Gothic horror, Dracula made
Christopher Lee an international star, and caused major American distributors
to compete to release Hammer’s films. Elegant but shocking, this first colour
adaptation of Bram Stoker’s novel offered Lee’s physicality and seductive
menace, opposite Peter Cushing’s fearless Van Helsing. Now, following the
discovery of film elements in a Warner Bros. warehouse, a brand new restoration
brings the original uncut version (previously only seen in Japan in 1958) to UK
cinemas for the first time! Halloween screening, with support from Croydon
Council.
Plus
a short (10 mins) exploring the film’s restoration.





SPECIAL OFFER:Save £2 by booking both Halloween Dracula films
at the same time. Ensure that both have been added to your basket before
checking out.
tmdb_overview: In late 15th-century Eastern Europe, Prince Vlad II’s bride is brutally murdered. As a result, he renounces God and damns Heaven itself. Cursed with eternal life, Vlad is reborn as Dracula, an immortal warlord who defies fate in a blood-soaked crusade to wrench his lost love back from death.

synopsis:
Dracula: Prince of Darkness 
Genre: HorrorUK | 1966 | 90 minsDirector: Terence FisherStars: Christopher Lee, Barbara Shelley, Andrew Keir
Transylvania, 10 years
after the events of Dracula. When four adventurous English holidaymakers fail to
heed warnings to keep well away from Dracula’s castle, they risk terrifying
consequences. This macabre sequel creates an intriguing sense of mystery, and
features the gun-toting Father Sandor (Andrew Keir) as Dracula’s primary
adversary. 

60th anniversary
presentation, in association with The Cinema Museum, of an original Technicolor
35mm ‘scope print.
SPECIAL OFFER:Save £2 by booking both Halloween Dracula
films at the same time. Ensure that both have been added to your basket before
checking out.
tmdb_overview: Whilst vacationing in the Carpathian Mountain, two couples stumble across the remains of Count Dracula's castle. The Count's trusted servant kills one of the men, suspending the body over the Count's ashes so that the blood drips from the corpse and saturates the blackened remains. The ritual is completed, the Count revived and his attentions focus on the dead man's wife who is to become his partner; devoted to an existence of depravity and evil.

movie_title: ENGLISH NATIONAL BALLET PRESENTS THE SLEEPING BEAUTY
movie_title_en: ENGLISH NATIONAL BALLET PRESENTS THE SLEEPING BEAUTY
synopsis:
English Nation Ballet Presents Sleeping Beauty 
Genre: PerformanceUK | 2026 | 160 minsDirectors: Ross MacGibbon, Kenneth MacMillan
This classic fairytale ballet with a famous Tchaikovsky
score, is choreographed by Sir Kenneth MacMillan and filmed from a limited run
at The Royal Albert Hall. As a baby, Princess Aurora is cursed by the wicked
Carabosse: on her 16th birthday, she will prick her finger and die. Her
godmother the Lilac Fairy alters the spell so Aurora will not die, but sleep
for 100 years. Only a true love’s kiss can break the spell and awaken her. An
exquisite version of one of the world’s favourite stories. 
Tickets £15.
tmdb_title: English National Ballet presents The Sleeping Beauty
tmdb_original_title: English National Ballet presents The Sleeping Beauty
tmdb_overview: A spellbinding fairytale ballet filmed at London’s Royal Albert Hall.  Sir Kenneth MacMillan’s exquisite ballet will leave you spellbound. A stunning version of one of the world’s favourite fairytales, filmed at London’s Royal Albert Hall.  Featuring First Soloist Anna Nevzorova as Aurora and Davi Ramos as Prince Désiré, the film will whisk you away to an enchanted land and a story of good versus evil. As a baby, Princess Aurora is cursed by the wicked Carabosse (Eireen Evrard). Her godmother, the Lilac Fairy (Anri Sugiura), alters the spell so Aurora will not die, but sleep for 100 years. Only a true love’s kiss can awaken her.  From Aurora’s christening in the palace, to her jubilant wedding, the bewitching tale is brought to life before your eyes through beautiful choreography, sumptuous costumes and stunning new projection sets by Charlotte MacMillan.

synopsis:
Late Fame 
Genre(s): Comedy/DramaUSA | 2025| 96 minsDirector: Kent JonesStars: Jake Lacy, Willem Dafoe, Greta Lee, Graham Campbell, Clark Johnson
Ed Saxberger (Willem Dafoe) is a
quiet New York post office worker who wrote a well-regarded book of poetry in
the late 1970s, before disappearing into obscurity. Decades later, a young
admirer (Edmund Donovan) tracks him down and introduces him to the “Enthusiasm
Society”, a group of privileged twenty-somethings who see Saxberger
as an overlooked literary genius from a bygone era of New York.

Flattered by their attention,
Saxberger is drawn back into the artistic world he left behind and develops a
fascination with Gloria (Greta Lee), the group’s charismatic theatrical spirit.
But as he becomes increasingly involved with his new circle, he begins to
question whether they truly admire his work or simply romanticise the idea of
the past they have created around him.
tmdb_overview: Legendary New York poet Ed Saxberger's forgotten works captivate an eccentric group of young creatives, reigniting his artistic passion. Their intrigue intertwines with the bewitching presence of actress Gloria.

synopsis:
Michael 
Genres: Biography | Drama | Music2025 | USA | 127 mins Director: Antoine FuquaCast: Jaafar Jackson, Juliano Valdi, Colman Domingo, Jayden Harville
Tracing the early life and meteoric
rise of one of the most influential artists of the 20th century, Michael charts
the journey of Michael Jackson from his beginnings as the precociously talented
lead singer of the Jackson 5 to his emergence as a global superstar during the
era of his landmark Bad tour. Portrayed by his nephew Jaafar Jackson,
the film explores the ambition, creativity and pressures that shaped his
ascent. Blending intimate moments with recreations of iconic performances, it
offers a portrait of the artist behind the phenomenon — capturing both the
brilliance and the drive that defined his early career.
Black History Month
screening in conjunction with Croydon Black History Partnership.
tmdb_overview: The story of Michael Jackson, one of the most influential artists the world has ever known, and his life beyond the music. His journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fueled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world, highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career.

synopsis:
Minions & Monsters 
Genre(s): AnimationUSA/UK | 2026 | 120 minsDirector: Pierre CoffinStars: Zoey Deutch, Allison Janney, Bobby Moynihan, Jesse Eisenberg, Jeff BridgesIn 1920s Hollywood, Minions are enjoying wild success as silent movie stars - until the ‘talkies’ arrive. James and Henry decide to make their own movie and summon fearsome monsters from a mysterious spellbook to play the villains. Lovecraftian creature Goomi leads them on a quest to find the ultimate monster, but when things go haywire, all Minions must band together to save the world. Look out for silent film star cameos and an all-star voice cast in this hugely enjoyable prequel to Minions (2015) and Minions: The Rise of Gru (2022).
tmdb_overview: Minions Stuart, Kevin and Bob are recruited by Scarlet Overkill, a super-villain who, alongside her inventor husband Herb, hatches a plot to take over the world.

synopsis:
NT Live: The Misanthrope

Award-winner Sandra Oh (Killing Eve) plays the title

synopsis:
Pressure 
Genre(s): DramaUK/France/USA | 2026 | 100 minsDirector: Anthony Maras Stars: Andrew Scott, Brendan Fraser, Kerry Condon Our Thursday 2pm screening contains descriptive subtitles for those with hearing loss and a post-screening discussion facilitated by the Croydon U3A film club. Anyone is welcome to stay behind for a fun chat.Pressure tells the
remarkable untold story behind one of the most important decisions of the
Second World War. In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, Britain’s chief
meteorological officer, Captain James Stagg (Scott), must convince Allied
commanders, including General Eisenhower (Fraser), whether the weather will
allow the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history to proceed.
With the fate of millions hanging in the balance, this is a fascinating look at
the people, decisions and the uncertainty that helped shape the course of
history. Gripping, intelligent and led by a stellar cast.

(Hannah Einbinder) gets the chance to reboot the long-dormant "Camp
Miasma" horror franchise, she's determined to do the series justice. Her
first step is to convince the original movie's "final girl", the
reclusive Billy Presley (Gillian Anderson) to return after decades away from

tribute to how our formative pop culture experiences can shape our lives - for
good and evil.

The Cycle of Love 
Genre(s): Documentary/Biography/Action/Adventure/Sci-FiUK/India/Sweden/USA| 2025 | 98 minsDirector: Orlando von EinsiedeStars: PK Mahanandia, Anne-Charlotte von Schedvin, Mina
Dale
In 1975, 23-year-old PK Mahanandia
makes a living drawing portraits for tourists in Delhi when he meets Lotta
(Anne-Charlotte von Schedvin), a Swedish student visiting India. Convinced
their meeting is destiny, PK recalls a childhood prophecy that he would marry a
musical woman from a far-off country, born under the sign of the ox. After
spending time together, Lotta returns to Sweden, promising to come back once
her studies are complete. But when she doesn’t return as planned and PK cannot
afford a plane ticket, he sells everything he owns, buys a second-hand bicycle
and sets off on a 6,000-mile journey across continents to find her.



Based on an extraordinary true
story, The Cycle of Love is a heart-warming tale of love, destiny
and the courage to risk everything for the person you love. Blending
documentary interviews with dramatised scenes, it’s an epic journey that we
challenge you not to shed a tear for!
tmdb_overview: Explores the romantic journey of PK Mahanandia, a Delhi street artist who trekked 6,000 miles by bicycle in 1977, venturing across continents to reunite with the woman he loved.

synopsis:
The Girls (Gehenu Lamai) 
Genre: DramaSri Lanka | 1978 | 110 mins (Sinhala with English Subtitles)Director: Sumitra PeriesStars: Vasanthi Chathurani, Ajith Jinadasa, Shayama AnandanThe BFI have released this
restoration of this well-loved film from 1978. Set in rural Sri Lanka, it tells
of schoolgirl Kusum, who cleans the house of a wealthy family, including their
son Nimal. He volunteers to tutor her through her exams, and although she knows
it will be frowned upon, she forms a romantic attachment to him. Meanwhile, her
younger sister Soma, enters beauty pageants and dreams of becoming a movie star
and escaping her lowly existence. Both Vasanthi Chathurani, who plays Kusum,
and director Sumitra Peries went on to have distinguished careers in Sri Lankan
cinema.

Shot in
just 23 days in chronological order on 35mm film, Olivia Wilde’s all star
ensemble chamber piece is excruciatingly awkward yet full of compassion and

tmdb_title: Last Dance at the Sundance Stompede
tmdb_original_title: Last Dance at the Sundance Stompede
tmdb_overview: In November 2023, over 800 people from all over the world gathered in San Francisco to attend the Sundance Stompede, an LGBTQ+ country-western dance weekend with four days of workshops and exhibition performances across three venues. After 27 years this year is the final Stompede. The film documents the weekend of dancing and the thoughts and reflections of 15 participants. As we journey into the weekend, a film about country-western dancing reveals deeper insights into the power of dance - not only to create community but to offer a profound healing of bodies and minds.

synopsis: Two train stewardess BFFs switch from a dull railway to the luxurious Glamazonian Express. During a massive storm, they must work with snooty first-class crew and President Gagwell to prevent disaster in LA.
tmdb_overview: Best friends and train stewardesses Tess and DeeDee trade their dreary shifts on the Stank Rail for the glitzy Glamazonian Express. However, when a catastrophic Stormaganza threatens to crash the high-speed train into Celebration, Florida, the duo in coach must join forces with the snobby first-class attendants, a hot but dimwitted co-conductor, and fabulous US President Judy Gagwell to save the day.

tmdb_title: The Last Guest of the Holloway Motel
tmdb_original_title: The Last Guest of the Holloway Motel
tmdb_overview: In 1970s Britain, Tony Powell was a star defender for Norwich City Football Club — until one day he disappeared from the public eye without a word to family or friends. Decades and seemingly a lifetime later, Tony now quietly resides at the Holloway Motel in the heart of West Hollywood as its manager and sole resident (apart from his dog Samantha). However, after he learns the motel is shuttering and he'll soon be evicted, Tony must finally reconcile his past and present in order to survive and come to terms with the multifaceted relationships of his life: those he's found, lost and abandoned.

tmdb_overview: After breaking up with his partner, 76 year-old Vicente leads life the way he likes it in Maspalomas: he spends his days lying in the sun, partying, and looking for pleasure. An unexpected accident obliges him to return to San Sebastián and to the daughter he abandoned years ago. Vicente will have to live in a retirement home where he finds himself driven back into the closet and to conceal a part of himself that he thought was long resolved. In this new environment, Vicente must ask himself if he has enough time left to make his peace with others… and with himself.

movie_title: Last Dance at the Sundance Stompede
movie_title_en: Last Dance at the Sundance Stompede
synopsis: In November 2023, over 800 people from all over the world gathered in San Francisco to attend the Sundance Stompede, an LGBTQ+ country-western dance weekend with four days of workshops and exhibition performances across three venues. After 27 years this year is the final Stompede. The film documents...
tmdb_title: Last Dance at the Sundance Stompede
tmdb_original_title: Last Dance at the Sundance Stompede
tmdb_overview: In November 2023, over 800 people from all over the world gathered in San Francisco to attend the Sundance Stompede, an LGBTQ+ country-western dance weekend with four days of workshops and exhibition performances across three venues. After 27 years this year is the final Stompede. The film documents the weekend of dancing and the thoughts and reflections of 15 participants. As we journey into the weekend, a film about country-western dancing reveals deeper insights into the power of dance - not only to create community but to offer a profound healing of bodies and minds.

tmdb_overview: In November 2023, over 800 people from all over the world gathered in San Francisco to attend the Sundance Stompede, an LGBTQ+ country-western dance weekend with four days of workshops and exhibition performances across three venues. After 27 years this year is the final Stompede. The film documents the weekend of dancing and the thoughts and reflections of 15 participants. As we journey into the weekend, a film about country-western dancing reveals deeper insights into the power of dance - not only to create community but to offer a profound healing of bodies and minds.

tmdb_title: Second Nature: Gender and Sexuality in the Animal World
tmdb_original_title: Second Nature: Gender and Sexuality in the Animal World
tmdb_overview: Did you know that clownfish change sex from male to female? (So if Nemo’s mom had died in real life, his dad could have become his mom!) Did you know that albatross, penguins and swans parent in same sex pairs? Or that bonobos, who are just as closely related to us as chimps, are matriarchal and have same-sex sex every day?!  Narrated by Elliot Page, Second Nature follows trailblazing Evolutionary Biologist Dr. Joan Roughgarden as she meets groundbreaking scientists exploring the 1500+ animal species who engage in same-sex sexual behavior and parenting, change sex, form matriarchies, and more,  debunking myths that females are “inferior” and that being queer is “unnatural.”  SECOND NATURE — everything you didn’t learn in high school biology.

synopsis: Legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans forms his perfect trio, recording two groundbreaking albums. When his brilliant young bassist dies tragically, Evans is devastated. The story follows Evans' journey to overcome grief and return to music.
tmdb_overview: June 1961, NYC: legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans has found his musical voice and created the perfect trio, including bass player Scott LaFaro, said to be his soulmate through music. A residency at New York’s Village Vanguard culminates in the live taping of two of the greatest jazz records of all time in one night. Ten days later, LaFaro dies in a car crash. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing.

synopsis: Drenched in Pedro Almodóvar's signature bright colours, Bitter Christmas is an intriguing, multilayered story about a director who borrows details from his loved ones' lives to flesh out his screenplay – much to their dismay.

The story of these women run parallel to that of a screenwriter and film director, exploring how life and fiction are inseparably linked, sometimes painfully so.

synopsis: Beautifully shot, with stunning performances by its young cast, the Oscar-nominated Mustang is both a rousing tale of spirited youth and a powerful, moving, and timely work of engaging social cinema. It’s the beginning of summer. In a small village in northern Turkey, Lale and her four sisters are on their way home from school, innocently playing with local boys. But prying village eyes view their games with suspicion and the girls’ behaviour – and refusal to repent – quickly causes a scandal am
In the horror of 1944 Auschwitz, a prisoner forced to burn the corpses of his own people finds moral survival upon trying to salvage from the flames the body of a boy he takes for his son.
At the dawn of World War III, a man searches for a way to restore peace to the world and finds he must give something in return.

Armed with a 16mm camera and a grant to make a documentary about the aftermath of William Tecumseh Sherman’s 1864 march to the sea, Ross McElwee gets sidetracked. After his girlfriend breaks up with him, Ross shifts his attention from the historical to the personal, to the battlefield of modern love, and embarks on a sociological chronicle that documents the courting rites and rituals of the New South. A generous and humanistic portrait of several remarkable women that Ross meets along the way,
tmdb_overview: Documentarian Ross McElwee originally set out to make a travelogue of sorts tracing General William T. Sherman's infamous scorched-earth march through the Confederacy in the latter stages of the Civil War. Instead, haunted by a recent breakup with a girlfriend, McElwee ends up documenting his progress -- or lack thereof -- in starting a new relationship. His journey then becomes one of self-reflection and self-discovery rather than a historical/sociological exploration.

synopsis: It's 1985. Vincent, almost 13, lives in the suburbs of Paris, caught between an older brother who brushes him off and parents who never stop arguing. tmdb_overview: In 1985 suburban Paris, 12-year-old Vincent lives with his distant older brother and quarrelling parents. Amid laughter and unease, he navigates friendship and first love, while beginning to confront the adult world.

synopsis: Drenched in Pedro Almodóvar's signature bright colours, Bitter Christmas is an intriguing, multilayered story about a director who borrows details from his loved ones' lives to flesh out his screenplay – much to their dismay.

The story of these women run parallel to that of a screenwriter and film director, exploring how life and fiction are inseparably linked, sometimes painfully so.

tmdb_overview: Documentarian Ross McElwee originally set out to make a travelogue of sorts tracing General William T. tmdb_overview: June 1961, NYC: legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans has found his musical voice and created the perfect trio, including bass player Scott LaFaro, said to be his soulmate through music. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing.

A residency at New York’s Village Vanguard culminates in the live taping of two of the greatest jazz records of all time in one night. Ten days later, LaFaro dies in a car crash. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing.

synopsis: It's a BRAND NEW DAY for Peter Parker. Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn’t remember him -- and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him -- sparks a change in Peter he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see. The world may have forgotten Peter Parker, but he hasn’t forgotten them.

synopsis: Armed with a 16mm camera and a grant to make a documentary about the aftermath of William Tecumseh Sherman’s 1864 march to the sea, Ross McElwee gets sidetracked. After his girlfriend breaks up with him, Ross shifts his attention from the historical to the personal, to the battlefield of modern love, and embarks on a sociological chronicle that documents the courting rites and rituals of the New South. A generous and humanistic portrait of several remarkable women that Ross meets along the way,
tmdb_overview: Documentarian Ross McElwee originally set out to make a travelogue of sorts tracing General William T. Sherman's infamous scorched-earth march through the Confederacy in the latter stages of the Civil War. Instead, haunted by a recent breakup with a girlfriend, McElwee ends up documenting his progress -- or lack thereof -- in starting a new relationship. His journey then becomes one of self-reflection and self-discovery rather than a historical/sociological exploration.

synopsis: In a mysterious forest, far from the borders of the China they’ve left behind, the painter Meng Huang and writer Ma Jian talk about exile, political opposition and artistic creation as a response to oppression and lies. The dissident writer, who has been unable to return to China, where all of his books are banned, since 2011, and the renowned painter living in exile in Berlin, are haunted by memories of the country they have fled. As leaves fall around them, they journey through the forest cont
tmdb_original_title: Parmi les montagnes et les ruisseaux
tmdb_overview: A mysterious forest in early fall echoes with birdsong and the sound of a river. Fallen leaves speckle gold on the blue stones. Two weary travellers make their way on foot – the painter Meng Huang and writer Ma Jian. When, as if after a long journey, they finally reach a cabin, they eat and drink, but the mood is not one of contentment. Their gaze is dark, haunted by memories of the China they have fled: persecution, resistance and the treatment meted out to those who fight for human rights. With the forest arousing painful thoughts and existential considerations, they talk about art. For the two artists, whose world view has been upended by the Tiananmen Square massacre, creation offers an answer to oppression and lies. But what kind of life remains for the exiles?

tmdb_overview: The deep sea is the last unknown territory on Earth. Here, biologists struggle to study the enigmatic wildlife that looks like something from another planet. But time is running out as deepsea mining threatens the fragile ecosystems.

After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK'S remaining members struggled to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members Emily Armstrong and Colin Brittain spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. movie_title_en: RBO Live 2026-27: Alice's Adventures In Wonderland
tmdb_title: Royal Opera House: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
tmdb_original_title: Royal Opera House: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
tmdb_overview: A full-length ballet created by choreographer Christopher Wheeldon for the Royal Ballet at the Royal Opera House, Covent Garden. The ballet is based on Lewis Carroll's famous story of Alice, an ordinary girl who one summer afternoon falls down a rabbit hole and finds herself on an extraordinary adventure.  The music is by Joby Talbot, with designs by the internationally acclaimed Bob Crowley. Alice is danced by the Royal Ballet's Lauren Cuthbertson, and actor Simon Russell-Beale plays the cameo role of the Duchess.

Valeriy Ovsyanikov conducts the Orchestra of the Royal Opera House in Tchaikovsky's glorious romantic score.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

synopsis: A multi-generational family of witches, cursed to be loveless for centuries, attempts to break the spell by confronting dark secrets and sacrificing for each other.
tmdb_overview: The Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.

In 2004, an ad director faces a turbulent Christmas weekend. In 2026, a filmmaker turns her story into a screenplay, blurring the lines between reality, fiction, and the people closest to him.
tmdb_overview: After her mother dies in December, advertising director Elsa immerses herself in work to cope. When a panic attack forces her to take a break, she decides to travel to Lanzarote with her friend Patricia. The story of these women run parallel to that of a screenwriter and film director, exploring how life and fiction are inseparably linked, sometimes painfully so.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

When a panic attack forces her to take a break, she decides to travel to Lanzarote with her friend Patricia. The story of these women run parallel to that of a screenwriter and film director, exploring how life and fiction are inseparably linked, sometimes painfully so.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis:
Academy Award® nominee Monica Barbaro (A Complete Unknown, Top Gun: Maverick) and BAFTA nominee Callum Turner (Masters of the Air, Fantastic Beasts franchise) star as Allie and Owen, two love-starved strangers who crash into each other in an ever-so-slightly fictionalized New York City on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

Recently dumped Owen and hopeful romantic Allie might be the only two singles in the city looking for more than just a quick encounter. They both feel a spark when they meet, but a series of missteps and side quests complicate their night, keeping them apart. As they each race toward and away from each other across the city, they just might discover that the one thing they want most is closer than they think.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis:
Ground control has been receiving mysterious transmissions from the three remaining residents of the Solaris space station. When cosmonaut and psychologist Kris Kelvin is dispatched to investigate, he experiences the same strange phenomena that afflict the Solaris crew, sending him on a voyage into the darkest recesses of his consciousness. 

With Solaris, the legendary Russian filmmaker Andrei Tarkovsky created a brilliantly original science-fiction epic that challenges our conceptions about love, truth, and humanity itself.
tmdb_overview: A psychologist is sent to a space station orbiting a planet called Solaris to investigate the death of a doctor and the mental problems of cosmonauts on the station. He soon discovers that the water on the planet is a type of brain which brings out repressed memories and obsessions.

synopsis:
Academy Award® nominee Monica Barbaro (A Complete Unknown, Top Gun: Maverick) and BAFTA nominee Callum Turner (Masters of the Air, Fantastic Beasts franchise) star as Allie and Owen, two love-starved strangers who crash into each other in an ever-so-slightly fictionalized New York City on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

Recently dumped Owen and hopeful romantic Allie might be the only two singles in the city looking for more than just a quick encounter. They both feel a spark when they meet, but a series of missteps and side quests complicate their night, keeping them apart. As they each race toward and away from each other across the city, they just might discover that the one thing they want most is closer than they think.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis:
As the Third Reich continues its reign of terror, Adolf Hitler is on a quest for the legendary Ark of the Covenant- resting place of the Ten Commandments- whose supernatural powers, legend says, can wipe out entire armies. The U.S. Government turns to Dr Indiana Jones for the mission.  Relentlessly pursued by Hitler's henchmen, Indy infiltrates their massive digging operation in a race against time to discover the Well of the Souls, where the Ark has lain undisturbed for centuries.

Screening on Sundays and Wednesdays as part of our Throwback Season, where we revisit classics. Each ticket to these showtimes includes complimentary popcorn and a drink.
tmdb_overview: When Dr. Indiana Jones – the tweed-suited professor who just happens to be a celebrated archaeologist – is hired by the government to locate the legendary Ark of the Covenant, he finds himself up against the entire Nazi regime.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

movie_title: Throwback: Raiders of the Lost Ark (45th Anniversary)
movie_title_en: Throwback: Raiders of the Lost Ark (45th Anniversary)
synopsis:
As the Third Reich continues its reign of terror, Adolf Hitler is on a quest for the legendary Ark of the Covenant- resting place of the Ten Commandments- whose supernatural powers, legend says, can wipe out entire armies. The U.S. Government turns to Dr Indiana Jones for the mission.  Relentlessly pursued by Hitler's henchmen, Indy infiltrates their massive digging operation in a race against time to discover the Well of the Souls, where the Ark has lain undisturbed for centuries.

Screening on Sundays and Wednesdays as part of our Throwback Season, where we revisit classics. Each ticket to these showtimes includes complimentary popcorn and a drink.
tmdb_overview: When Dr. Indiana Jones – the tweed-suited professor who just happens to be a celebrated archaeologist – is hired by the government to locate the legendary Ark of the Covenant, he finds himself up against the entire Nazi regime.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis: In 2004, an ad director faces a turbulent Christmas weekend. In 2026, a filmmaker turns her story into a screenplay, blurring the lines between reality, fiction, and the people closest to him.
tmdb_overview: After her mother dies in December, advertising director Elsa immerses herself in work to cope. When a panic attack forces her to take a break, she decides to travel to Lanzarote with her friend Patricia. The story of these women run parallel to that of a screenwriter and film director, exploring how life and fiction are inseparably linked, sometimes painfully so.

synopsis:
Academy Award® nominee Monica Barbaro (A Complete Unknown, Top Gun: Maverick) and BAFTA nominee Callum Turner (Masters of the Air, Fantastic Beasts franchise) star as Allie and Owen, two love-starved strangers who crash into each other in an ever-so-slightly fictionalized New York City on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

Recently dumped Owen and hopeful romantic Allie might be the only two singles in the city looking for more than just a quick encounter. They both feel a spark when they meet, but a series of missteps and side quests complicate their night, keeping them apart. As they each race toward and away from each other across the city, they just might discover that the one thing they want most is closer than they think.

tmdb_overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

Academy Award® nominee Monica Barbaro (A Complete Unknown, Top Gun: Maverick) and BAFTA nominee Callum Turner (Masters of the Air, Fantastic Beasts franchise) star as Allie and Owen, two love-starved strangers who crash into each other in an ever-so-slightly fictionalized New York City on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

Recently dumped Owen and hopeful romantic Allie might be the only two singles in the city looking for more than just a quick encounter. They both feel a spark when they meet, but a series of missteps and side quests complicate their night, keeping them apart. As they each race toward and away from each other across the city, they just might discover that the one thing they want most is closer than they think.

The story of these women run parallel to that of a screenwriter and film director, exploring how life and fiction are inseparably linked, sometimes painfully so.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis:
PRESENTED BY RANGE ROVER
Join us at Everyman at The Whiteley on Monday, 14 September, for Soundtracking Film Club, in partnership with Range Rover, for a special screening of Extra Geography.  Across a series of 10 specially curated events, the partnership is formed around a shared belief in excellence, craftsmanship and the power of extraordinary experiences. 

Following the film, Edith Bowman will be joined by producer Sarah Brocklehurst, director Molly Manners, screenwriter Miriam Battye, actors Galaxie Clear and Marni Duggan, to discuss the making of Extra Geography, sharing behind-the-scenes stories and insights from their experiences on set.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis: In 2004, an ad director faces a turbulent Christmas weekend. In 2026, a filmmaker turns her story into a screenplay, blurring the lines between reality, fiction, and the people closest to him.

When a panic attack forces her to take a break, she decides to travel to Lanzarote with her friend Patricia. The story of these women run parallel to that of a screenwriter and film director, exploring how life and fiction are inseparably linked, sometimes painfully so.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis: In 2004, an ad director faces a turbulent Christmas weekend. In 2026, a filmmaker turns her story into a screenplay, blurring the lines between reality, fiction, and the people closest to him.
tmdb_overview: After her mother dies in December, advertising director Elsa immerses herself in work to cope. When a panic attack forces her to take a break, she decides to travel to Lanzarote with her friend Patricia. The story of these women run parallel to that of a screenwriter and film director, exploring how life and fiction are inseparably linked, sometimes painfully so.

synopsis:
Four lifelong friends realise that somewhere between careers, relationships, families and everyday responsibilities, they have forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. 

Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for what turns out to be an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.
tmdb_overview: Three friends go on a spa weekend that descends into chaos when their trainwreck friend joins, leading to hilarious consequences.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

movie_title: Exhibition On Screen: James McNeill Whistler
movie_title_en: Exhibition On Screen: James McNeill Whistler
synopsis:
In an era of great change and great beauty emerged the character of James McNeill Whistler. Considered by some to be one of the great innovators of 19th century art, he was a contemporary of the Impressionists, much admired by Van Gogh and Manet. Boldly experimental and famously witty, Whistler disrupted the strict conventions of Victorian society in pursuit of a new cult of beauty, creating “art for art’s sake” and earning himself a place in the history of great art. He found a parallel between painting and music, and entitled many of his paintings “arrangements”, “harmonies” and “nocturnes”, emphasizing the importance of tonal harmony in his work.

His most famous painting, Arrangement in Grey and Black No. 1 (1871), commonly known as Whistler’s Mother, is a revered and often parodied portrait of motherhood. It is arguably one of the most famous paintings in history and this film will unveil the artist behind the art.

Tate Britain is now holding the first major retrospective of Whistler in three decades. This blockbuster exhibition promises to reawaken the world to just how important Whistler is to art history, uniting world-famous masterpieces with rarely seen works. Exhibition on Screen will bring these stunning works and the incredible story behind them to cinemas around the world while the exhibition is still running, bringing this truly global artist to a global audience. This will be an unmissable chance to get to know this visually spectacular artist and the influence he has had on those who followed.

synopsis:
Academy Award® nominee Monica Barbaro (A Complete Unknown, Top Gun: Maverick) and BAFTA nominee Callum Turner (Masters of the Air, Fantastic Beasts franchise) star as Allie and Owen, two love-starved strangers who crash into each other in an ever-so-slightly fictionalized New York City on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

Recently dumped Owen and hopeful romantic Allie might be the only two singles in the city looking for more than just a quick encounter. They both feel a spark when they meet, but a series of missteps and side quests complicate their night, keeping them apart. As they each race toward and away from each other across the city, they just might discover that the one thing they want most is closer than they think.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis: In Insidious: Out of the Further, Amelia Eve stars as Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. synopsis:
Tired from decades of being blown up by explosive ACME products whilst in pursuit of the uncatchable Road Runner, Wile E. Coyote teams up with lawyer Kevin Avery (Will Forte) to fight back in COYOTE vs. ACME. But ACME has its own powerhouse defence attorney in Kevin’s slick nemesis Buddy Crane (John Cena), who is determined to silence Wile E. and Kevin.

Wile E. and Kevin embark on a wild quest for justice that’s as thrilling and physics-defying as Wile E.’s lifelong chase for the ever-speedy Road Runner.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis: Survivors of a deadly pandemic traverse a post-apocalyptic landscape to find the origin of a mysterious radio transmission.
tmdb_overview: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
Academy Award® nominee Monica Barbaro (A Complete Unknown, Top Gun: Maverick) and BAFTA nominee Callum Turner (Masters of the Air, Fantastic Beasts franchise) star as Allie and Owen, two love-starved strangers who crash into each other in an ever-so-slightly fictionalized New York City on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

Recently dumped Owen and hopeful romantic Allie might be the only two singles in the city looking for more than just a quick encounter. They both feel a spark when they meet, but a series of missteps and side quests complicate their night, keeping them apart. As they each race toward and away from each other across the city, they just might discover that the one thing they want most is closer than they think.

synopsis: In 2004, an ad director faces a turbulent Christmas weekend. In 2026, a filmmaker turns her story into a screenplay, blurring the lines between reality, fiction, and the people closest to him.
tmdb_overview: After her mother dies in December, advertising director Elsa immerses herself in work to cope. When a panic attack forces her to take a break, she decides to travel to Lanzarote with her friend Patricia. The story of these women run parallel to that of a screenwriter and film director, exploring how life and fiction are inseparably linked, sometimes painfully so.

synopsis:
Four lifelong friends realise that somewhere between careers, relationships, families and everyday responsibilities, they have forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. 

Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for what turns out to be an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis:
Ground control has been receiving mysterious transmissions from the three remaining residents of the Solaris space station. When cosmonaut and psychologist Kris Kelvin is dispatched to investigate, he experiences the same strange phenomena that afflict the Solaris crew, sending him on a voyage into the darkest recesses of his consciousness. 

With Solaris, the legendary Russian filmmaker Andrei Tarkovsky created a brilliantly original science-fiction epic that challenges our conceptions about love, truth, and humanity itself.
tmdb_overview: A psychologist is sent to a space station orbiting a planet called Solaris to investigate the death of a doctor and the mental problems of cosmonauts on the station. He soon discovers that the water on the planet is a type of brain which brings out repressed memories and obsessions.

movie_title: Soundtracking Film Club: Sense and Sensibility + Live Q&A
movie_title_en: Soundtracking Film Club: Sense and Sensibility + Live Q&A
synopsis:
PRESENTED BY RANGE ROVER
Join us at Everyman at The Whiteley on Wednesday, 16 September, for Soundtracking Film Club, in partnership with Range Rover, for a special screening of Sense and Sensibility.  Across a series of 10 specially curated events, the partnership is formed around a shared belief in excellence, craftsmanship and the power of extraordinary experiences. 

Following the film, Edith Bowman will be joined by actors Daisy Edgar-Jones and Esme Creed-Miles, and director Georgia Oakley to discuss the making of Sense and Sensibility, sharing behind-the-scenes stories and insights from their experiences on set.

From Focus Features and Working Title comes an irresistible new take on Jane Austen’s iconic Sense and Sensibility: a charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood starring Daisy Edgar-Jones and Esmé Creed-Miles.
tmdb_overview: A concept live performance by n-buna, combining recitation and musical performance, held from September to October 2025.  This video features footage from Yorushika's LIVE TOUR 2025 "Plagiarism Re-enactment".

synopsis:

Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms.

Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis:
Academy Award® nominee Monica Barbaro (A Complete Unknown, Top Gun: Maverick) and BAFTA nominee Callum Turner (Masters of the Air, Fantastic Beasts franchise) star as Allie and Owen, two love-starved strangers who crash into each other in an ever-so-slightly fictionalized New York City on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

Recently dumped Owen and hopeful romantic Allie might be the only two singles in the city looking for more than just a quick encounter. They both feel a spark when they meet, but a series of missteps and side quests complicate their night, keeping them apart. As they each race toward and away from each other across the city, they just might discover that the one thing they want most is closer than they think.
